info.name: Adobe Analytics Annotations Server Call Estimate API
Adobe Analytics Get Server Call Estimate

params.name: dateRangeStart
params.description: Start of the date range for the repair in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: dateRangeEnd
params.description: End of the date range for the repair (inclusive) in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)

items.docs: Calculates the number of data rows that would be scanned for a repair job given the specified report suite and date range. This estimate is required before creating a repair job and returns a validationToken that must be passed to the job creation endpoint. The count determines the cost of the repair.
